text: Written review for Figo Pet Insurance. It gives me a real good feeling that my pet Rex has really good coverage. I want to take good care of my beloved Lab mix, my best friend: Rex!

Too many bugs. App is no longer compatible with older devices.. In 2013, I got the fresh elements solo automatic feeder. As of Fall 2024, the app is no longer compatible with this device. So I cannot edit the feeding schedule in the device itself no longer even shows on the app.

As of April 2025, I’ve tried updating the app with no success in having the issue resolved. Instead, the app says “System error” on every page. It won’t allow me to create any new data, families, pet profiles, or add a new device. 

FIX THESE ISSUES DEVS. PLEASE.
Professional & friendly. Staff was great & was very patient

Fake 5 star reviews!. Worst insurance experience ever. Every time I’ve made a claim I’ve been given the runaround. No matter how many invoices and literally HAND WRITTEN vet notes you submit, they will still claim there’s insufficient documentation to justify reimbursement
Dumb. New update has decided that it’s just not gonna feed the cats at the scheduled time? Super confused.
App just times out. About as good as their product. In short, useless.

No longer usable. I log in with my email and a code sent to the email, then it tells me to bind said email and wants to send me a code to bind but then says it’s already binded to me which is what I logged in with.  A never ending loop and now I can’t access my devices.
Can’t Figure Out How to Sign Up. This seems like an amazing and useful app! But I can’t figure out how or where to sign up…

Frustrated with Server Outage. Hopefully this gets the attention of the developers and the public relations departments. The debacle that is this server outage has frustrated a whole community of users that rely on this technology to have peace of mind knowing that their pets are being fed while they are away at jobs, visiting relatives, etc. And to not get any notifications of a broader outage on any official platforms (app, website) is embarrassing. I had to learn of the outage by checking DownDetector and Reddit. REDDIT. Absolute shambles how this is being handled, and I am seriously considering alternative options and dropping Petlibro for good.
Gr8!. Greatest…cat…fountain…EVER!  If u luv ur floofs, get this!

“Request timed out, please try again later”. The app IS AWFUL. I’ve had these for maybe 5 hours so far(I bought three automatic feeders)and it’s done nothing but crash and give me ^^^. I was able to set a schedule, FINALLY, then they all discontinued from the WiFi and I had to restart the entire process. It’s 2026, there is no excuse for an app on my phone to function so poorly. Idk what’s going at Petlibro, BUT THEY NEED TO FIGURE IT TF OUT.
Two paws up. We have two little dogs and they drink a lot of water. This makes it much more easier to keep their bowl full.

Worst Buy Ever. I purchased a Petlibro Luma Litter box that refuses to pair with the app. I’ve reached out to Petlibro on multiple attempts and still no response. The litter box is essentially a large paperweight. And there is no direct number to contact for support. Only an email that they never respond to.

Scammy Ad. The app keeps opening an ad for their “Care & Care Plus” when I’m trying to setup a feeding schedule. The back button on the ad won’t work and I have to force close the app. Avoid this product.

Beware!. I had a $500 deductible with a 70% "reimbursement" plan.  One would think that it would cover 70%.  NOT AT ALL. After my dog started vomiting and could not stop I decided to take him to the after hours vet.  He is 2.5 years old and has no preexisting condition.  I had a false sense of confidence because I had pet insurance.  Had I not had pet insurance I probably would have waited a bit before taking him to the vet.  My dog was fine.  The visit was $1,000 and Figo covered $100?  It is a SCAM!
Doesn’t work anymore. Just blank screen saying request timed out.

Time zone error. It is constantly telling me that the time zone between my phone and the device are not the same but it doesn't tell me how to change the time zone on the device and I don't remember ever setting up a time this is annoying

Clunky and full of useless features. UPDATE: it’s missing my current policy, so I can’t submit claims on the policy I’m paying for. Now it’s a completely useless app.

Original review:
If you like the loading screen of doom, lots of useless features, and wannabe “AI” with your pet insurance, this is the app for you. 

I get nostalgic for dial-up every time I have to use this app. Every screen takes forever to load and because it’s not that intuitive, you end up going to the wrong places and have to wait for it to load before you go back to find the right place. I was using the vet chat yesterday, and every time my phone went to sleep, it took forever to get the chat back up to respond. 

I have this app for my pet insurance, not for a dog-Facebook. It’s honestly kind of creepy and invasive - I wish I could opt-out or not have my dogs picture on there (I have to have a picture on my current dog account cause my account has dogs who are no longer with us and I can’t remove them). All I want is to see my policy, chat to a vet, and file claims. My dog doesn’t need a social app. 

The “AI” claims experience gives off Amazons grab and go store with the “AI” checkout vibes - trying to be something is not to hop on whatever the cool thing in tech is doing. It’s pretty obnoxious since there isn’t an option to skip it. 

I miss the old app - trail tracks. It wasn’t perfect but at least it didn’t take forever to load and it was easier to use.

Feeder is good but the app is not. So the feeder works well and the camera view is good. What I don’t understand and have reported why I cannot stay logged in with more than ONE iDevice!!! If I move from my iPad to my M1 Mac I have to log back in. Petlibro claimed this is for security. Come on - is your security that less than my 7 security cams that allow me to stay logged with many devices?
What’s Happening?. I’m in an app update loop and cannot use the app at all. When will it be fixed?
Unusable. For whatever reason, the app and the website are inaccessible.  Loading screens that don’t end and now, you try to log in and it just takes you back to the login screen.

Great Pet Fountain - 1 quirk. So far the best we’ve had. Filters aren’t to costly and plenty of options to bulk (6) buy at competitive prices. 

Water is kept clean from fur, and bits of food. It appears the pets drink more and of the 3 water sources we have out. It is preferred.

Easiest to clean and after months. No water crust build-up in bowl or parts typical of plastic and ceramic fountains. Also, the pump is a breeze to clean since the water is filtered before returning. 

The downside is water level observation. There is no way to gauge water level without removing top to look, and to fill. A water gauge / sensor or clear window would be great. As it’s difficult not to spill water when checking and adding. Keep on tile or water capture tray if placed on wood or carpet surface. Minor issue you get use to once a cadence of how often to check to refill. Average is every 2 days in summer and winter.
Schedule doesn’t always repeat. App is buggy— even when setting the repeat schedule indicator, some days it will randomly skip

Empty Canister Food Alarm Malfunction. No matter how many times I reset the alarm, an hour later it goes off again…while full of food. It’s irritating because I need to leave it toggled on (in the app) so I know when the canister actually needs to be refilled. Otherwise, great product.

Not the best.. I’ve had tons of issues with the app already & i’ve only had it like a week. constantly says it can’t load & to try again later so i can’t see my cats water activity. also has gone offline like 10 times for no reason as my wifi is completely fine

This is the worst app ever. The app is constantly crashing. I cannot speak to a live vet without it crashing after every message. Nothing loads. Half the time, I can’t even log in. I’m so upset because it’s a great insurance policy at a fair rate. I just can’t use the app!!

Functionally Useless Now. I’ve used a PetKit automatic feeding device for years, but in the past few weeks have lost any functional access with the app. The old app version would not let me access my device even after manually re-adding it. Now the new version says “Network Error” repeatedly even though I am on working wifi. I have no way to access the product I paid for. It’s deeply disappointing when companies stop supporting older devices.

Clunky app for an outdated business. App is slow and clunky especially with documents. Overall Figo seems to be about 5 years behind the competition in terms of service and offerings. They are overpriced for their coverage.

Company does not pay out. Just got a puppy and thought insurance would help pay for all the costly bills/typical vet care that you have in the beginning. Thought WAY more covered than actually did. Out of the $1000 plus that I submitted, 90% didn’t qualify. One of my claims was too late to submit. You only deal with AI, and it’s hard to get an actual person. I asked for a one time curtesy, and got denied. Wouldn’t choose again.
Updates. This latest update disconnected all my devices and doesn’t allow you reconnect, thanks for screwing up the system, just another technician with less experience than my pets…

Products don’t work as advertised. I purchased the wet and dry feeders. The dry feeder has mostly worked except for instances when the app is updating and the product becomes nonfunctional for a few days. The wet feeder stopped working after 2 months. I have been trying to contact customer service over the last month. Their response time is pitiful. It takes a week in between messages to receive a response and the steps provided don’t solve the problem. Then, you have to wait 7-10 days to get another response. In this day and age I haven’t dealt with a company with such poor customer service in a long time. Do not buy from this company. They are a scam and do not provide quality products.
Worst. The app is so broken I can't even log in
EVEN WORSE AFTER UPDATE. STOP UPDATING THE APP!!! WE DO NOT NEED AI IT IS MAKING IT WORSE. I CANNOT CONNECT MY DEVICES. PLEASE YOU ARE AN AUTO WETFOOD FEEDER NOTHING ELSE, LEAVE IT ALONE!

Pop ups and ads. The app is slowly losing functionality- instead of being able to feed my cats I need to click through pop ups for products I am not interested in. I am going to switch feeders for something that doesn’t have such an obnoxious, barely usable app.

When it actually works it’s amazing!. I genuinely love these products when I first got them. I’m the owner of the automatic wet food pet feeder and a dock stream. The automatic feeder has had issues three times this year, where the food tray keeps spinning incessantly. My cat is now too afraid to eat her food and this product has become obsolete. Most times when you contact support they’ll just send you another one. I don’t want another one, I want the products to work for me long-term. There’s constant bugs in their firmware probably causing this. Find another option if you’re looking for a wet food feeder. I’m over this.
Buyer Beware!. The automatic feeders rely on the Petlibro service to dispense food and will quit working if it goes down. It’s been so for days. Terrible design!
Terrible Company. Do yourself a favor and go with another Insurance company that will actually pay out claims. App is more like social media than actual insurance.
Animal fedder. The best fedder i was using for animal a long term…
App won’t update. App is saying it needs to be updated but it is up to date

Buggy firmware updates. The most recent firmware update to the polar wet food feeders has the timers not working properly. The device will close too soon, open too late, or not open manually. Switching brands immediately.
